classification.difficultyReason: The cue supplies the bisecting perpendicular, leaving a single cos⁻¹ with half the base.

content.prompt: Find the value of $\theta$. Answer to 1 decimal place. Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base. In an isosceles triangle it bisects the base.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base. In an isosceles triangle it bisects the base, so each half is $2.5$. Adjacent $=2.5$, hypotenuse $=9$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{A}{H}\\\cos\theta&=\frac{2.5}{9}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{2.5}{9}\right)\\\theta&\approx73.9^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
